summary: Candidate describes the composite pattern of nesting @session (root) and @agent/@operation (children) decorators to establish span hierarchy. This is semantically a workflow composition of two existing micro_skills: Session Span Initialization (root span) and Agent Operation Span Tracking (nested operations). The candidate's core capability—establishing parent-child span relationships through decorator nesting—is the integration of these two peer skills, not a distinct capability. Merging avoids duplication and clarifies that proper span hierarchy emerges from correct composition of session and agent decorators.
